Whoever is out there will hardly be happy about competition for divine power.

Even at the peak of their power, Nihaz and Hirkalla did not completely subjugate the Domain of Death; it has its own deities appointed by the All-Mother. The same rulers of death as Hirkalla originally was, these powerful entities will not accept anyone's dominion over them. Tep will spend some time fighting them...

In the absence of Hirkalla and Nihaz, after we dealt with the Architect, Light and Chaos came to the fore.

The Light is represented by the heralds and servants of Enod, but Chaos... Nihaz tried to subjugate it, too... but is it possible to subjugate the antithesis of order itself?

If Tep decides to act outside of Sarnaut, Chaos will make things difficult for him.

Who, then?

Catherina? After the debacle on the Eclipse, the great sorceress learned some sense - she will not ally herself with an obvious madman.

Elves? The ruined Great Ball and the "vampire problem" did not earn him any friends among them. The vampires themselves were also disappointed in Tep.

The Sculptor? He didn't throw Tep out of Ferris for nothing...

And to Cosmos he is as much an enemy as Nihaz and Hirkalla.

His only allies are pariahs like him, madmen and maniacs. But thanks to our joint efforts, there are fewer of them... I wish my sister stopped resurrecting everyone indiscriminately...
r512706.n: Maybe he will find someone else?

t:
Looks like it. The last time he returned, the great necromancer tried to stir up trouble in the League and the Empire.

Yermolai's death, the troubles after the Great Ball, Skulnar's first "death", the accident in Lab 13... Sounds familiar? Tep was behind it all.

Many nurse a grudge now, so it will be hard for him to find allies. Last time he relied on Armando and his minions from ZIT Headquarters... But we dealt with the vampires, and the Empire has caught plenty of moles over the past years.

For now we need to recover our strength and gather allies!

Tep is more cautious and less arrogant now: he won't rush into someone else's trap - he'll set his own. So rushing headlong into danger is a bad idea.

My sister has connections outside of Sarnaut and she's going to use them.

We... must be vigilant. Tep has never acted alone. He will probably try to revive his cult, gathering what's left of it.

r512709.n: Quelles sont tes intentions, en fin de compte ?

r512710.n: Plutôt compliqué, tout ça... Mais si c'est vrai, alors... Qu'est-ce que ça signifie ?

r512711.n: Personne ne sait en quoi les Eidos sont impliqués dans cette histoire...

r512712.n: J'ai l'impression que tu es du genre à prendre des risques... Même quand ils sont…

r512714.n: Je parle de Nefer Ur ! Il a failli réduire le monde à néant !

r512715.n: Tu veux bien m'expliquer ce qui vient de se passer ?

t: Hello! Sun, air, and water are our best friends!
r512716.n: Hello! Sun, air, and water are our best friends!

t: So our little hero has grown up and can handle everything on their own? Well, go on, then. I'm definitely not stopping you...
r512927.n: I don't need your help anymore, Alice. I can figure it all out myself.

t:
The City of Demons...

The atrium of Gorluxor's Tower and the most sinister place in Sarnaut at this time. Why would you want to go there? Let me remind you.

So it all started with the events in the Holy Land, when the cultists led by Gorluxor, the rebellious Great Mage from the Empire, tried to destroy the Gift of Tensess. Or rather, their goal was to claim this Gift for the demons. You managed to thwart their plans.

But it turned out that the world the League and the Empire had believed in for the last fifty years was false. The demons were not defeated at the June Gates during the Great Astral Campaign. They are still active, and they are trying to destroy the allods.

The realization brought you all here. You rightly believe that Gorluxor and his cultists are behind everything. That's why you are now standing here at the Gates of this City.

After working out a truce, the League and Empire are about to storm it. Are you ready to join the attack? Or do you want to know what happened next?
r512928.n: Yes, I want to know what will happen in the City of Demons.

t:
What is insanity? They say insanity is doing the same thing over and over again. And expecting different results. If so, then Tep is clearly insane...

After all, he had to resurrect over and over again for thousands of years. Really, I could never understand why people are drawn to him... After all, only a madman can believe this maniac.

Do you know how Tep keeps his cultists? First, he promises them the world, eternal life, and all that. Then he demands an entrance fee and a monthly tax - part of the Spark's radiance. Finally, the newcomer is sent to recruit other unfortunates. Brought a new fool into the cult? Get a sip of his life. If you screwed up, you pay with your own. Such is Tep's Pyramid...
r512930.n: Yes, I want to know what happens in Tep's Pyramid.
